status: Proposed immutable contract for root approval; no candidate source yet.
benefit: Continue the existing Mendelian lesson's explicit unequal-gamete limit with an original linkage lesson and bounded phase/testcross lab.

admission: Input is a non-null, non-array object whose prototype is Object.prototype or null.

Exactly two own string keys, phase and recombinationPercent, and no own symbols. Both are data descriptors; enumerable or non-enumerable data fields are admitted. Required inherited fields, extra own fields and accessor fields refuse. Accessor values are not invoked; there is no general Proxy side-effect guarantee.

phase is exactly 'coupling' or 'repulsion'; recombinationPercent is a strict Number integer in [0,50], excluding NaN/infinities, booleans, strings and coercion. Negative zero is admitted and copied as positive zero.
Malformed input throws TypeError or RangeError and returns no partial result. Message wording and which of those two error classes is chosen for a particular refusal are not public contracts.
Input values, properties, descriptors, prototype and extensibility are unchanged.
model.ordering: Result own key insertion order follows the schema above. input keys are phase,recombinationPercent; parent genotype,homologs; tester genotype,gamete; row gamete,kind,probability,offspringGenotype; fraction numerator,denominator. Rows are always AB,Ab,aB,ab. Totals and marginal keys follow the shown order.
model.phase: coupling homologs=['AB','ab']; repulsion homologs=['Ab','aB']. A row matching either homolog is 'parental'; the other rows are 'recombinant'. These kind tags remain at 0 and 50 percent.
model.fractions: Each parental row has (100-r)/200 and each recombinant row r/200. Reduce by integer gcd; positive denominator; canonical zero is 0/1. All numerators/denominators are exact safe Number integers. All four rows remain, including zero-probability rows.
model.offspring: Tester ab maps AB→AaBb, Ab→Aabb, aB→aaBb, ab→aabb. This model does not calculate phenotypes or alter allele labels.
model.summary: totals sum row probabilities by kind and overall. marginals sum rows carrying each indicated allele. independentComparison.probability is 1/4 and matches means every current gamete row equals 1/4, without inferring chromosome location.
model.immutability: The result and every nested array/object are frozen copies. The already frozen LINKAGE_ASSUMPTIONS array may be shared; no mutable input reference is retained.
assumptions: Hypothetical diploid plants; two autosomal loci A/a and B/b.
One double-heterozygous AaBb parent is crossed with an aabb tester that contributes ab.
Alleles segregate equally; the two parental gamete classes share probability equally, as do the two recombinant classes.
The entered recombination percentage is a stipulated recombinant-gamete fraction, not a count of crossover events.
No mutation, segregation distortion, differential gamete or offspring survival, or nonrandom fertilization is modeled.
Probabilities describe possible offspring; they are not quotas for a finite sample and do not locate genes on a physical chromosome map.

course.title: Linked genes: same genotype, different gametes
course.outline: Original questions distinguish unphased AaBb from two chromosome arrangements; parental/recombinant identity; exact gamete weights and fixed-tester offspring; model probabilities versus finite observations; recombinant gametes versus crossover events; and the lack of a physical-location conclusion at 50 percent.
course.authorship: Entirely original wording, hypothetical plant scenarios, distractors, diagrams and worked transfers. Original course text/questions CC0-1.0; cited sources retain their own terms. No source exercise, passage, image or answer key is copied.
course.blindBoundary: After authoring, a prompts/options-only packet with exact IDs/concepts is frozen for independent solving. No answer indices, explanations, guide solutions or authored-key tests are disclosed to the scientific receiver before its answers are sealed.
course.consumer: Unchanged parseDeck validates exact course bytes. Existing file chooser→preview→explicit Start this deck→first-answer review→separate missed-item practice→study notes; no learner/model/catalog/source changes.
course.limitations: Original prerequisite links are teaching/selection hints, not measured mastery or a validated sequence; no learner-efficacy, real-organism, medical or genetic-counseling claim.

ui.initial: coupling and raw text '20'; unapplied, result hidden, observation download disabled; fixed course download available. No automatic calculation, presets, inference or storage.

form.#linkage-phase: select: coupling label 'AB / ab'; repulsion label 'Ab / aB'
form.#linkage-recombination: text input with inputmode=numeric; label 'Recombinant gametes (%)'

ui.grammar: Raw percentage text length at most 32 UTF-16 code units. ECMAScript trim, then one or more ASCII digits; Number value must be 0..50. Leading zeros and surrounding whitespace accepted; blank/signed/decimal/exponent text refused. Observation retains original committed raw text.
ui.commit: Apply reads actual controls, validates and commits one complete analysis and exact entered values. On successful Apply show result; on refusal keep no stale result and display visible error. Input/change on either control synchronously retires applied result/observation availability, even on same-value round trips.

resultBindings.#linkage-result: result container, hidden until valid Apply
resultBindings.#linkage-independent-match: Matches independent assortment OR Differs from independent assortment

ui.presentation: Visible original AaBb genotype and fixed aabb tester. Original homolog schematic is explicitly not a physical map/scale. All model assumptions are readable. Literal text is rendered as text, not HTML. Semantic labels, keyboard focus, announced status/errors, 375px layout; any table-only scrolling stays within its container.
ui.network: Self-contained built HTML with inline CSS/JS/course, no runtime HTTP/provider/font dependencies, automatic storage, uploads or learner-session mutation. Relative learner/guide links require the retained repository layout.

observation.label: Download this cross (.json)
observation.schema: {format:"recallweave-genetic-linkage-observation/1",entered:{phase:<exact selected enum>,recombinationPercent:<exact applied raw string>},analysis:<complete analyzeLinkage result>}
observation.bytes: UTF-8 JSON.stringify(payload,null,2)+'\n', with property insertion order shown above and no BOM/timestamp.
observation.lifetime: Before preparation reread actual controls and compare their exact raw values with committed values. A mismatch or retired result refuses and retires observation availability, even when no input/change event was dispatched. A later edit does not rewrite an already downloaded snapshot.

downloads.repeat: Each explicit activation may initiate a download; unchanged observation downloads are byte-identical. No automatic download, duplicate suppression or download-busy Apply lock is promised.
downloads.failure: Preparation errors are visible and preserve any still-current applied analysis for explicit retry. A course preparation failure does not retire the cross. No browser filesystem-delivery guarantee is inferred from click dispatch.
